The '''Aldereen system''' was located within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to the [[Aldereenian]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TCoPL" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aldereen system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square M-14.<ref name="TEA" />
